changeSet.sql: UPDATE direction d SET nom = v.nouveau, last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() FROM region r, (VALUES ('CCQ', 'CELLULE COMMUNICATION ET QUALITE'), ('DRH', 'DIRECTION DES RESSOURCES HUMAINES'), ('DSI', 'DIRECTION DES SYSTEMES D''INFORMATION') ) AS v(sigle, nouveau) WHERE r.id = d.region_id AND upper(trim(r.nom)) = 'NIAMEY' AND upper(trim(d.nom)) = v.sigle
